test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum of money doubles itself at a certain rate of compound interest in 12 years when the interest is compounded annually. In how many years will it become eight times of itself?
solution:
**Given:**

Time to double = 12 years

**Formula used:**

For doubling: A = P(1 + r/100)¹² = 2P

For becoming 8 times: A = P(1 + r/100)t = 8P

**Calculation:**

⇒ (1 + r/100)¹² = 2

⇒ (1 + r/100)t = 8

⇒ 8 = 2³

⇒ (1 + r/100)t = (1 + r/100)¹² × ³

⇒ t = 12 × 3

⇒ t = 36 years

**∴ The sum will become eight times of itself in 36 years.**
